  2. No7 Pro Artist Luxe Powder Blush 5g

Silky and buildable, this powder blush creates a soft-focus flush of colour to enhance your cheekbones for a natural-looking glow with a lasting finish.

Add a pop of colour with this weightless, light-diffusing blusher. The buildable formula creates a blendable soft-focus flush.

Available in 5 silky shades for an effortless pop of colour.

Pink Blush - a cool pink

Taupe Blush - a soft true mauve

Coral Blush - a soft beige peach

Fuschia Blush - a soft rosy glow

Rose Blush - a rosy peach pink

Why You'll Love It:

Lightweight & Buildable: Buildable colour to effortlessly wake up cheeks with a soft-focus flush of colour

Achieve a natural-looking blush to your look in three simple steps:

Step 1: Start by applying your favourite No7 foundation

Step 2: Using a powder/blush brush, Sweep Pro Artist Luxe Powder Blusher onto the apples of your cheeks, blending upward along the cheekbones. Layer as desired.

Step 3: To lock in your look, finish your regime by spritzing the No7 Pro Artist Finishing Touch Fixing Spray over the face.

Coral :

Synthetic fluorphlogopite, Mica, Caprylic/Capric triglyceride, Silica, Magnesium stearate, Broron nitride, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Diisostearyl malate, Ethylhexyl palmitate, Aluminum hydroxide, Phenoxyethanol, Tocopheryl acetate, Capryly glycol, CI 77492 (iron oxides), CI 73360 (red 30), CI 77491 (iron oxides), CI 77499 (iron oxides).

Fuschia :

Synthetic fluorphlogopite, Mica, Caprylic/Capric triglyceride, Silica, Magnesium stearate, Boron nitride, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Diisostearyl malate, Ethylhexyl palmitate, Phenoxyethanol, Aluminum hydroxide, Tocopheryl acetate, caprylyl glycol, CI 77891 (titanium dioxide), CI 45410 (red 28 lake), CI 73360 (red 30).

Pink :

Synthetic fluorphlogopite, Mica, Caprylic/Capric triglyceride, Silica, Magnesium stearate, Boron nitride, Triehoxycaprylylsilane, Diisostearyl malate, Ethylhexyl palmitate, Phenoxyethanol, Aluminum hydroxide, Tocopheryl acetate, Caprylyl glycol, CI 77491 (iron oxides), CI 45410 (red 28 lake), CI 73360 (red 30), CI 77492 (iron oxides).

Rose :

Synthetic fluorphlogopite, Mica, Silica, Caprylic/capric triglyceride, boron nitride, Madnesium stearate, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Aluminum hydroxide, Diisostearyl malate, Ethylhexyl palmitate, Phenoxyrthanol, Tocopheryl acetate, Caprylyl glycol, Aminopropyl triethoxysilane, CI 77491 (iron oxides), CI 77492 (iron oxides), CI 73360 (red 30), CI 77499 (iron oxides), CI 77891 (titanium dioxide), CI 19140 (yellow 5 lake), CI 1580 (red 7 lake).

Taupe :

Synthetic fluorphlogopite, Mica, Silica, Caprylic/Capric triglyceride, Boron nitride, Magnesium stearate, Triethoxycaprylysilane, Aluminum hydroxide, Diisostearyl malate, Ethylhexyl palmitate, Phenoxyethanol, Tocopheryl acetate, Caprylyl glycol, CI 77491 (iron oxides), CI 77492 (iron oxides), CI 77499 (iron oxides), CI 73360 (red 30).
